title: Chapter 316 Entering The Depths
content:
Chapter 316 Entering The Depths

Seeing the three of them stop the dispute, everyone around who were watching the game breathed a sigh of relief.

At this time, Lu Xue actually stepped forward and began to explore the mural on the bronze wall.

In just a moment, Lu Xue's eyes lit up.

"Haha, I didn't expect that this little girl's understanding was so terrifying."

In the dim room, the phantom looked at Lu Xue in the projection and couldn't help but praise.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng, who was standing beside him, was indifferent on the surface, but he felt a little proud in his heart.

I feed my daughter all kinds of top-notch treasures every day, but I don’t have high performance.

Chen Mingyu had to comprehend a long time mural, but Lu Xue just touched it and directly realized the true meaning.

The gap is clear at a glance.

"Sister Xue, what did you find?"

Xiao Luo noticed that Lu Xue was a little strange in behavior, and then stepped forward and asked.

Qin Feng also looked at Lu Xue.

However, Lu Xue ignored the two of them and spoke to Tang Hao in the distance: "Senior Brother Tang Hao, the way to enter the depths of the bronze palace is hidden in this mural."

Lu Xue's voice was not concealed.

When everyone around heard this, their expressions lit up and they ran to the murals to comprehend.

Tang Hao was also slightly stunned.

He has just recovered now and is thinking about what to do next.

Unexpectedly, Lu Xue told him directly.

But what he didn't understand was that Lu Xue couldn't tell him secretly.

Now, Ye Wuwei and Chu Xingyue also ran to the mural and began to comprehend.

"Sister Xue, what are you doing?"

Seeing that everyone present was immersed in the meditation mural at this moment, Xiao Luo couldn't help but say curiously.

Isn’t it good to know this matter, but I secretly understand it myself.

At that time, you can first enter the depths of the bronze palace and seize the opportunity.

Looking at Xiao Luo's curious look, Lu Xue gave him a blank look and said, "Where do you think Chen Mingyu is now?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was slightly stunned.

"Chen Mingyu? He, he should,"

Suddenly, Xiao Luo was shocked suddenly.

If Chen Mingyu is not here, he must have entered the depths of the Bronze Palace.

If Lu Xue didn't tell everyone just now, but entered directly, wouldn't they just look like Chen Mingyu and others?

At that time, Chen Mingyu will not be beaten to death.

Thinking of this, Xiao Luo was scared.

She is worthy of being Sister Xue.

"You should go and comprehend quickly, as this thing has many benefits."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Xiao Luo no longer hesitated and hurriedly ran to a mural and began to comprehend.

In this way, except for Lu Xue and Ao Qing, the rest entered a state of comprehending.

Of course, Lu Xue naturally won’t do anything.

First of all, there is no need.

Except for Chen Mingyu, she didn't want to kill these people.

Also, although these people seem to be concentrating on the murals, if she makes any moves, she will definitely be noticed.

There is no simple character who can get here.

I don't know how long it took.

A fairy light lit up and the first person who understood it appeared.

"Hahaha, so that's it, so that's it!"

Looking along the sound, I saw that the first person to understand was Qin Feng.

Tang Hao and the other two in the distance were not moving at this moment.

Looking at Qin Feng who was happy, Lu Xue suddenly remembered, by the way, his father had personally promoted Qin Feng and Xiao Luo.

Obviously, the understanding is also part of the improvement.

Sure enough, just a moment later, Xiao Luo also made a move.

"This bronze palace is so mysterious."

Xiao Luo opened his eyes, and a fairy light suddenly shot out from his eyes.

And when Xiao Luo looked at the rest of the people who were still comprehending, he was slightly stunned.

Damn it? He is so awesome.

After a while, Chu Xingyue also understood and slowly stood up.

But her eyes looked at Lu Xue and others intentionally or unintentionally.

Then came Ye Wuwei and Tang Hao.

The three of them all looked at Lu Xue and the others, with a complicated expression.

Unexpectedly, there is an existence that is more sensible than them, and it is so much higher than them.

It's simply incredible.

People who can reach their level have a terrifying understanding.

But now, three of them appear here in a row.

Wouldn't that mean that if nothing unexpected happens, Lu Xue and the other three will achieve less than the other three in the future?

"Since you understand, then go in."

Perhaps it was a little anxious, or perhaps it was because Tang Hao was afraid that Ye Wuwei and the others would do something to Lu Xue and others, Tang Hao suddenly said.

After all, they are all students of Tiandi Academy.

Hearing Tang Hao's words, Ye Wuwei and the others nodded slightly.

Immediately, Tang Hao walked to the mural, where a lifelike figure with a bronze mask was carved.

Above it, the bronze palace was glowing with strange colors.

Tang Hao did not hesitate and touched directly at the bronze palace.

The next moment, the space trembled.

A passage suddenly appeared in front of Tang Hao.

The passage opened, and Tang Hao rushed in without saying a word of nonsense.

Then there were Ye Wuwei and Chu Xingyue.

"We'll go in, too."

Lu Xue spoke.

Immediately, Lu Xue and others also entered it.

As the light flashed in front of them, everyone suddenly found themselves in a huge hall.

Around them, there are countless dark door holes, and I don’t know what it is inside.

At the end of the distance, there is a huge bronze statue. The statue is still wearing a bronze mask. He holds the bronze palace high in his hand and looks into the distance with deep eyes and a bit majestic.

"This, is this?"

Ye Wuwei said a little shocked.

Looking at the statue in the distance, a terrifying sense of oppression was that it soared into the sky from the soles of her feet.

Not only Ye Wuwei, but the rest of the people are the same.

Except Lu Xue.

Just when everyone was frightened, a huge fighting sound suddenly came from a distance.

Hearing the movement, Tang Hao and the others reacted first and looked at a door hole.

Tang Hao said in a low voice: "It must be that guy Chen Mingyu!"

After saying that, Tang Hao rushed in directly.

"Sister Xue, are we going to have a look?"

Xiao Luo, who wanted to go directly to watch the show, stopped and looked at Lu Xue who was indifferent to the side and asked.

He is now used to asking Lu Xue before doing things.

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

"There are many door openings here, and I believe there are many opportunities."

"Let's go to the other side and try to act together."

Lu Xue felt that there seemed to be some danger here.

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly pointed to a door not far from the right and said, "My master, let's go there."

"good."

Without hesitation, Lu Xue went straight to the door hole Ao Qing pointed to.

When he was in place, Ye Wuwei and Chu Xingyue looked at each other.

"Miss Chu, I'll go and plunder it too, you can do it yourself."

Ye Wuwei left a confident smile and then disappeared from the spot.

Looking at the empty surroundings, Chu Xingyue looked cold and silent for a moment, she looked at the bronze statue in the distance.
